_comment: Layout synergies (our own touch, not FarmVille 2009): placed homes of one kind that touch pay more. A group lists the catalog families it covers; a member's neighbours are the other pieces of the SAME item whose footprints share an edge with it. Each neighbour adds `per_neighbour` to the coins of every collect, up to `max_neighbours`. Add a group here and it works, no code.
